title: Ordinary higher direct image vanishes on an affine neighbourhood basis
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq S$ an open, $F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $p\in\mathbb N$. Put $Y=f^{-1}U$, $g=f|_U:Y\to U$, and $G=F|_Y$. If $H^p(g^{-1}V,G)=0$ for every affine open $V\subseteq U$, with cohomology computed by the ordinary derived open-section functor [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], then $(R^pf_*F)|_U=0$, where $R^pf_*$ is the ordinary right derived module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. No quasi-coherence, quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, or positive-degree assumption is imposed.

source.place: Cohomology, Tags 01E1 (lemma-restrict-injective) and 01E4 (lemma-higher-direct-images); stalk-zero conclusion and affine neighbourhood basis

proof.text: Put Y = f inverse-image U, T = U.toScheme, g = f restricted to U, and G = F restricted to Y. Supply EnoughInjectives on Y using moduleSheaves_abelian_enoughInjectives and take Mathlib injectiveResolution G. Let K = g_*I and P = sectionCohomologyPresheaf K p. For each affine V of T, exact evaluation gives (L.sc p).mapHomologyIso E, where L is the underlying presheaf-module complex and E is abelian evaluation at V. Composing its inverse with the inverse of I.isoRightDerivedObj for openModuleSections Y (g inverse-image V) identifies P(V) with the cohomology object in the hypothesis. Transport IsZero along this isomorphism. Termwise equality of the section complexes is definitional for moduleDirectImage.

For any x of T, represent a stalk element of P by a germ on an open V using TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq. Mathlib exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset gives an affine W containing x and contained in V. The value P(W) is zero by step 1, so its carrier is subsingleton. By germ_res_apply the original germ is the germ of the restriction to W, which equals zero. Thus every element of the module stalk is zero. The third clause of higherDirectImagePresheaf makes the stalk map of sectionCohomologyTheta followed by the inverse resolution comparison an isomorphism onto the stalk of R^p g_*G. Transport IsZero through this isomorphism and forget the scalar action to obtain zero abelian stalks.

Apply Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero to the underlying abelian sheaf of R^p g_*G, then use faithfulness of SheafOfModules.toSheaf to reflect the zero identity. To compare with restriction of R^p f_*F, resolve F on X. Restriction along the source open preserves injectives by restrict_injectiveResolution and overEquiv; transport through overFunctorEquiv. Restriction preserves limits because its underlying abelian presheaf is precomposition by the open-image functor, and preserves colimits because it is a left adjoint. Its mapped augmented complex is therefore an injective resolution J of G. Construct the underived pushforward/restriction natural isomorphism using pushforwardComp, the image-preimage equality for the cartesian square, and pushforwardCongr2. The equality of scalar maps follows from the square equality via appLE_comp_appLE. Apply this isomorphism termwise, take homology, commute homology with exact target restriction, and compose isoRightDerivedObj for J and the original resolution. Transport IsZero along the inverse of the resulting isomorphism. The comparison is constructed locally; no import of DirectImage.Sections or HigherDirectImageOpenRestriction is needed. Degree zero and empty opens are included.

DirectImageHomologyAffineDetection handles unbounded derived objects globally, not ordinary direct image restricted to an open. theorem isZero_restrict_higherDirectImage_of_affine_basis
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (U : S.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ (V : U.toScheme.Opens), IsAffineOpen V →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.toRingedSpace p
        ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).obj (Scheme.Modules.restrict F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι))) :
    IsZero (Scheme.Modules.restrict
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj F) U.ι)
